keyLimits.en: Mobile app with receipt scanner, unlimited expenses, mileage tracking, basic integrations (Uber, Lyft, Slack), single approval flow, multi-country compliance.
Adds per diems/daily allowances, online accounting integrations (QuickBooks, Xero, Exact), automated card reconciliation, customizable policies, multi-level approvals, custom fields.
Adds Rydoo Cards, SFTP access, API access, priority support. Active-user pricing: billed only for users who perform an action that month.
Adds AI-powered Smart Audit, advanced approval workflows, insights dashboard, SAML SSO, HR connect, scheduled exports.

cautions.en: Essentials and Pro require a minimum of 5 users; not usable as a true single-seat plan.
Business and Enterprise plans use active-user billing, so cost is not simply seats x price.

capabilities.en: OCR receipt scanning via mobile app for automated expense capture.
Mileage tracking and multi-country tax/compliance support.
AI-powered Smart Audit that automatically analyzes all expenses (Enterprise tier).
Accounting integrations with QuickBooks, Xero and Exact from the Pro tier up.

limitations.en: Essentials and Pro plans require a minimum of 5 seats, ruling out true solo use.
API access and SFTP export are gated behind the Business plan (30-seat minimum, quote-based).

reason.en: Direct competitor for expense management and card spend control for SMEs.
Overlaps for expense reports, cards and finance automation in Europe.
Competes for expense tracking and company card management.

missingAlternatives.name: Expensify
missingAlternatives.reason: Major expense reporting competitor with OCR receipt scanning, not in the catalogue.

unknowns: No free trial length was stated on the pricing page; self-service signup exists but trial terms are unclear.
